q=quotes.copy()
q['n']=q.vendor.map(names)
g=q.groupby('n').agg(lines=('rm_code','count'),hist=('otif','count'),otif=('otif','mean'),defect=('defect_rate','mean'),claim_otif=('otif_claim_pct','mean'),claim_def=('defect_claim_pct','mean'),late=('late_days','max')).round(3).reset_index()
g['otif']=(g.otif*100).round(1);g['defect']=(g.defect*100).round(2)
g['status']=g.apply(lambda r:'No history' if r.hist==0 else ('Good' if r.otif>=95 and r.defect<=1 else 'Watch'),axis=1)
result=g
